# Courses and training {.display-name style="font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,3.2rem)"}

::: {.lede style="font-size:1.05rem; margin-top:1.2rem"}
Five years of MSc econometrics at Justus Liebig University Giessen, and a continuing
training programme for economists at the World Bank.
:::
:::

::: {.card-grid style="padding-top:2rem"}

::: {.flat-card}
[MSc · English · 2020–2024]{.eyebrow style="font-size:0.62rem; letter-spacing:0.16em"}

### Introduction to Statistics and Econometrics

Foundations for social-science research: probability, estimation, inference, and the linear
model, taught with applied agricultural and development data.

::: {.chips}
[OLS]{.chip} [Inference]{.chip} [R]{.chip}
:::
:::

::: {.flat-card}
[MSc · English · 2020–2024]{.eyebrow style="font-size:0.62rem; letter-spacing:0.16em"}

### Advanced Econometrics in the Social Sciences

The mostly-harmless toolbox for getting from a cause to an effect: panel methods,
instrumental variables, difference-in-differences, and regression discontinuity.

::: {.chips}
[DiD]{.chip} [IV]{.chip} [RDD]{.chip} [Panel data]{.chip}
:::
:::

::: {.flat-card .featured}
[Open Learning Campus · 2025–]{.eyebrow style="font-size:0.62rem; letter-spacing:0.16em"}

### AI-assisted coding for economists

A World Bank course on using AI responsibly in R and Stata workflows — taken by more than
600 staff, with an accompanying seminar series.

::: {.chips}
